functions.name: each
functions.signature: List Nat → Nat → Option Producer.Cursor → Eff [] (List Nat × Producer.Cursor × Option Nat)

functions.name: whole
functions.signature: List Nat → Nat → Option Producer.Cursor → Eff [] (List (List Nat) × Producer.Cursor × Option Nat)

functions.name: paced
functions.signature: List Nat → Nat → Option Producer.Cursor → Eff [] (List Nat × Producer.Cursor × Option Nat)

functions.name: tick
functions.signature: Nat → Option Producer.CycleCursor → Eff [] (List Nat × Producer.CycleCursor × Option Nat)

graphs.name: main
graphs.program:
do
  let n ← input "n" Nat
  let name ← input "name" String
  let _ ← double n
  greet name

graphs.name: each
graphs.program:
do
  let xs ← input "xs" (List Nat)
  let item ← each xs
  double item

graphs.name: whole
graphs.program:
do
  let xs ← input "xs" (List Nat)
  let batch ← whole xs
  sum batch

graphs.name: paced
graphs.program:
do
  let xs ← input "xs" (List Nat)
  let item ← paced xs
  double item

graphs.name: tick
graphs.program:
do
  let value ← tick
  double value
